Adult Protective Services
Department of Senior and Adult Services
The intent of the adult protective services is to protect and assist adults 60+ who may be victims of abuse, neglect, self-neglect and/or financial exploitation.
Children and Family Services Training
Department of Children and Family Services
The Professional Development and Learning Department is the host site for the North Central Ohio Regional Training Center (NCORTC), one of eight Ohio Child Welfare Training Programs (OCWTP) that provides high quality, competency-based, culturally-responsive, family-centered, in-service training for child welfare professionals and licensed/approved caregivers.
County Shared Services
Department of Regional Collaboration
Cuyahoga County currently offers the following shared services to municipalities and other multi-jurisdictional local government agencies.
Emergency Services
United Way 2-1-1
Serving 26 counties and covering 3.5 million people in Ohio, the United Way 2-1-1 Help Center provides free and confidential 24-hour access to a compassionate professional who will review your options for help, develop a plan and act as your advocate if you are faced with barriers to service. Simply dial 2-1-1 or chat with us for assistance. Se habla Espanol.
Health and Human Services Reports
Department of Job and Family Services
Annual reports, reports to the community, brochures, guides.
Home Support Services
Department of Senior and Adult Services
If you are a Cuyahoga County resident and live in your own home or apartment, chances are we can help you receive the support services you need to live independently right at home.
Job and Family Services
Department of Job and Family Services
Sign up to receive the Community e-Newsletter or sign up for Special Events
Job and Family Services Speakers Bureau
Department of Job and Family Services
Provides free information and presentations to your agency, customers or community groups about services available to Cuyahoga County residents. Programs topics can be modified to fit the needs of the organization that has an interest in scheduling a speaker. Please complete the Online Speaker’s Bureau Request Form if you wish to schedule this service.
Public Information Services
Department of Public Works
Public notices, records information request, media information request form.
Public Safety and Justice Services
Public Safety and Justice Services
Public safety and emergency management reports and publications.
Selective Services for those Reentering the Community
Office of Reentry
According to the federal Bureau of Justice Assistance, “Re‐entry refers to the transition of offenders from prisons or jails back into the community.” This population is defined as all persons who have been convicted of a criminal offense and are physically and mentally returning to society, whether or not they have served executed time on a federal, state, or local level.
Senior and Adult Services Publications
Department of Senior and Adult Services
Information to empower seniors and adults with disabilities to age successfully by providing resources and support that preserve their independence.
Senior and Adult Services Reports
Department of Senior and Adult Services
Strategic plans, semi-annual performance reports, surveys, statistical data and annual reports.
Senior Services
Department of Senior and Adult Services
Programs and services available to Seniors living in Cuyahoga County.
Services for Children with Incarcerated Parents
Family and Children First Council
The Children of Incarcerated Parents Community Engagement Forums educate about the needs of children with incarcerated parents and effective responses to address those needs, and hear from local and national experts on this topic in the areas of research, providing services, and living within families impacted by incarceration.
Services for Families
Family and Children First Council
Resource directory of child and family public service agencies for Cuyahoga County.
